title: unified-rollouts-model-lifecycle-composite-metric-autorollback
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Improve safety of model rollouts by adding a composite-metric auto-rollback engine that evaluates multiple telemetry signals (latency p95, error-rate, request-quality-regression) with configurable quorum and weighting. This PR implements the composite metric evaluator, integrates it with the existing probing/staged shadow canary workflow, and adds observability + e2e tests. Design summary: 1) Composite evaluator takes a list of metrics, individual thresholds, weights, and a quorum policy. 2) Probing stage emits metric snapshots for candidate variants; evaluator computes a rolling score and triggers rollback when composite score crosses configured thresholds and quorum conditions are met. 3) Added safeguards: cooldown windows, manual quarantine markers, and opt-out annotation per rollout. 4) Observability: new rollout_telemetry composite_score and decision_reason labels, alert rules for persistent degradation. Checklist: - [x] implement composite evaluator core and config schema - [x] integrate evaluator into rollout controller - [x] add staged shadow probing hooks - [x] wire decision events to audit log and tracing - [x] add unit tests for quorum logic and weighting - [x] add integration e2e tests simulating degraded model - [x] update docs and Linear tickets. Related: builds on work from ENG-318 (staged probing) and ENG-294 (rollback observability). Backwards compatibility: evaluator defaults to existing single-metric behavior if composite config absent. Rollout plan: land on main behind feature flag rollouts.composite_autorollback; enable in canary for internal staging first, monitor composite_score, then flip for non-sensitive customers. Implementation notes: key files changed include rollout/controller (adds evaluateCompositeScore), telemetry exporter (adds composite_score metric), and e2e harness that can inject synthetic telemetry. Testing: local unit tests + CI matrix across release/* branches; e2e tests added to perf-canary job. CI had a flaky integration run that required a retry; final CI green. Merge: squash and merge with descriptive message.
